map_sources.description: List of map sources to add (OSM, TMS, or WMS). Each item is a map object with properties like id, hostname, url, etc., as documented in the man page for maps.xml configuration files. The source_type determines the GObject class (VikSlippyMapSource, VikTmsMapSource, or VikWmscMapSource). Note: SlippyMapSource is the default for standard OSM-like tiles. TMS and WMS support fewer properties in this template implementation due to complexity, focusing on core tile fetching properties which are shared or specific to SlippyMapSource in the example logic. For full TMS/WMS support, one would need to extend this schema. Here we use a flat list where 'source_type' specifies the class suffix (Slippy, Tms, Wms). For SlippyMapSource, all properties apply. For others, many are inherited but optional. To keep schema flat and compliant, we define the common properties that apply to VikSlippyMapSource as the primary example, noting that TMS/WMS have subsets. However, the man page says TMS/WMS support properties 'as per VikSlippyMapSource above'. So we can use the same object structure for all three classes, just changing the class name suffix. This simplifies the schema significantly while remaining valid for all three types as per the docs.
